description: __amsg_exit differs from every archive member tried in all four modules (jgld 0x10082870 66.7%, Terrain 0x10019c80 66.7%, exe 0x004a6937 80.0%, sound 0x1004319b 53.3%). description: Two of the seven C3 rows lifted by identity (sound __checkTOS_withFB 0x48268, strcpy 0x4a010) and every memcpy / memmove / strchr row reach 100% only through byte identity with relocation sites masked (the CSV rows are 16-byte blocks, not instructions), because match.py's table check reads the jump tables inside memcpy / memmove as one tail. Equal bytes outside relocations, and each section-local relocation holding address + label + stored addend, is stricter than the instruction comparison, but C4_PLAN.md names only the instruction comparison.
path to resolution: The lead decides whether byte identity counts as library-object identity; the two promote lines are marked in 7_promote_cmds.txt and can be dropped.
